excerpts.content: What would happen if there were several blocks with merge ttd distributed at the same time, with different nodes receiving different blocks first? The first proposer chooses and others accept even if locally their head is different?

excerpts.author: ajsutton
excerpts.content: Consensus layer fork choice rules take over and decide which chain is canonical.

excerpts.author: 0xsadcat
excerpts.content: Yes but on the lowest level that means first proposer overrides pow head for everyone right? Otherwise it could stall

excerpts.author: ajsutton
excerpts.content: Not necessarily. If there's a fork on the beacon chain there may be multiple beacon blocks which are the merge block for their chain and fork choice will choose between them.
